title: What should the furnace supplier confirm before I make wire-coil support stands?
summary: Wire-coil stands determine both support and the hot-air passage beneath the load. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s recirculating-air bogie-hearth resistance-furnace proposal dated 24 December 2023 assigns hearth stands to the buyer. They support the workpieces while leaving a bottom circulation passage connected to side air guides. Specify stands together with the bogie surface, loading pattern and guides; do not select a set of blocks solely by total weight after the furnace design is fixed.
